name: Clare Cooden
title: Editor and briefing host
bio: Puts each edition together and presents the evening briefing.

name: Rob Sidley
title: Crime and courts correspondent
bio: Covers police appeals, charges and court cases across Rother.

name: Anya Udimore
title: Politics correspondent
bio: Follows both MPs, the district council's politics and elections.

name: Hugh Pebsham
title: Council and public services reporter
bio: Turns Rother and county council decisions into what they mean for you.

name: Jess Peasmarsh
title: Community and people reporter
bio: Writes about the people, charities, schools and events of Rother.

name: Owen Etchingham
title: Business reporter
bio: Covers local shops, farms, jobs, openings and closures.

name: Kit Ninfield
title: Traffic and roadworks reporter
bio: Knows every closure on the A21, A259 and A2100. Brisk and useful.

name: Mabel Bodiam
title: Local history writer
bio: Tells a story from the history of Rother and the 1066 Country.

name: Tess Iden
title: Picture editor and illustrator
bio: Finds a photo for every story and, when no real one fits, draws an illustration instead. Never pictures real people or makes a scene look like a photo of the actual event.
